Bug_Title: RV: Random value from 0 to 1 is coerced to the integer 0 (RV_01_TO_INT)
Bug_Details:
A random value from 0 to 1 is being coerced to the integer value 0. You probably
want to multiply the random value by something else before coercing it to an integer, or use the Random.nextInt(n) method.
 Random.nextInt(n)
Bug_Explanation: The bug is present in the showBug method. A random value from 0 to 1 is being coerced to an integer value 0 by multiplying the random value by 10 before typecasting it to an integer.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case asserts that the result of the showBug method should not be equal to 0. This is because the showBug method returns an integer and it is coerced from a random double value which ranges from 0 to 1, but since we are multiplying by 10 before typecasting to int, it has a possibility to return 0. The test case is supposed to fail, thus triggering the bug.
